mission: Capacity75 session 12: deployment-provenance-divergence compares each service with what it runs (collector runtime inputs, API watch patterns), not the repository head (tooling only)

impacts.reason: State generator only: per-service provenance decision. Collectors current when scripts/collector_runtime_inputs.py reports no changed runtime input between the deployed commit and the head; API and market-index-snapshot current when no watched path changed (Railway watchPatterns, read only); frontend must equal the head. Off-history commits, disagreeing platform/marker SHAs and undeterminable graphs still diverge. No Railway, Vercel or database write; no collector, API or web code change; scripts/ is outside every collector image and watch path.

Both cases: false alarm cleared (collector on its release commit after docs/web merges; API skipped for a docs merge) and real divergence still fires (collector behind a runtime-input change, off-history commit, watched API change, undeterminable inputs/patterns, SHA disagreement, frontend behind head).
Records the new provenance rule and the session-12 counterfactual on real history.
